variable.name: average air temperature
variable.source: NASA POWER (MERRA-2), monthly, 0.5 x 0.625 degree grid

sentence: Since 2001, average air temperature is rising with convincing evidence in 14% of the world's 207936 grid cells and falling in 0%. In the other 85% a change is not proven.
method: Sen's slope; Mann-Kendall test with variance scaled by lag 1 autocorrelation of what is left after a smooth curve (effective sample size; a straight line for ranges under 20 years); Benjamini-Hochberg FDR on maps
